analysis.AN_Notes: Prompting is the benchmarking instrument (5-shot prompts) and the evaluated mitigation; the work concludes that prompting can serve as an effective mitigation, so Recommended_Practice is also coded. Techniques: few-shot examples with anti-stereotypical invented Winograd sentences (ICL), chain-of-thought prompts including the schematic short variant and the phrase 'Proceed step by step' (Thought_Generation), and a context-supplying system instruction (General_Guidance), verbatim: 'Translate the following sentence from English to Catalan while mitigating gender bias.' followed by the instruction to 'ensure fair gender treatment in the output'. Evaluated: the work's own experiment on Llama-2-7B-chat; the top prompt (invented anti-stereotypical Winograd 5-shot plus short chain-of-thought) raised WinoMT gender accuracy markedly and reduced bias on Gold BUG and less on MuST-SHE, at a slight loss of translation quality; context on gender bias or MuST-SHE examples alone gave no improvement (Sections 6.2, 7, 8). KI_Sonstige teilweise for the neural machine translation baselines. AN_Task Other_Task: machine translation English to Catalan and Spanish. Harm types: correlation with pro-stereotypical sets (Stereotyping), male default without gender cues (Exclusionary_Norms), lower female F1 and the male-female accuracy gap Delta G (Disparate_Performance). Gender is analysed only as binary male/female, stated in the ethical statement; the work defines gender bias but not gender. Friedman and Nissenbaum and the representational/allocational distinction are cited to motivate the definition and do not frame the analysis as theory.

analysis.AN_Notes: Conceptual article on algorithmic decision-making (ADM) in social work with case studies (Allegheny Family Screening Tool, COMPAS, NDIS, HEALER, Heat List) and a proposed technical-critical pedagogy. Bias axes from the case studies: race (COMPAS error rates, over-policing through the Heat List), disability (practitioner bias towards children with a disability that the AFST may counter; NDIS needs assessment) and socioeconomic disadvantage (conclusion on groups with social-economic disadvantage, AFST rent and school attendance variables). Harm types: a racially different false-negative rate (Disparate_Performance) and disadvantage through proxy variables such as proximity to known shooters, producing over-policing of African-American communities, together with AFST predictions based on invalid correlations (Indirect_Discrimination). Mitigation: critical, case-based social work education, mandatory interpretative screening and human review (Organisational_Process); Demonstrated because the authors report applying the case-study method in their own undergraduate teaching, without an evaluation of its effect on bias.
